阅

Read it, or listen to it. Same page.读着听，听着读，进度接得上。

Yuyue reads your books aloud one sentence at a time and highlights each sentence as it goes. Stop listening, start reading, and you are on the same line.

语阅一句一句地朗读你的书，读到哪句就亮哪句。听到一半拿起来看，正好停在那一行。

  • Tap any sentence to start

    Reading aloud starts from the sentence you tap, and the page turns on its own.

    点哪句，从哪句读

    点任意一句就从这句开始读，读完自动翻页。

  • Help with books in English

    Tap a word for its meaning, double-tap a sentence to translate it, and keep a word list.

    读外文原著

    点词看释义，双击整句翻译，生词记进生词本。

  • Your books stay yours

    No account and no ads. Books and notes live on your device and sync only to storage you choose.

    书和笔记只在你手里

    不用注册，没有广告。书和笔记存在你的设备上，只同步到你自己选的网盘。

Coming soon to the App Store. Free.

即将上架 App Store，免费。
